methodological_rigor.justification: The provided manuscript contains only a title and lacks any description of the study design, experimental procedures, or statistical methods. As no methodological or statistical details are present, the claims cannot be evaluated or supported.

clinical_relevance_loe.justification: This study is classified as Oxford Level 5 evidence because it is a preclinical investigation utilizing human cholangiocarcinoma cell lines (Sk-ChA-1 and Mz-ChA-1). While the research identifies a potential therapeutic mechanism involving survivin and Bcl-2 in a difficult-to-treat malignancy, the findings are limited to in vitro assays without in vivo validation, rendering the translational path speculative.

reporting_quality.justification: The manuscript is explicitly labeled as retracted and contains no content beyond the title, precluding any evaluation of reporting standards or data sharing. No methodology, results, or supplementary materials are available for review. Consequently, it fails to meet any criteria for reporting quality or reproducibility.

novelty_literature.justification: The study provides an incremental extension of existing knowledge by applying Guggulsterone to cholangiocarcinoma cell lines, but the mechanisms described—caspase-dependent apoptosis and downregulation of survivin and Bcl-2—are well-established for this compound in other malignancies. Similar findings regarding Guggulsterone's anti-cancer properties have been documented since the early 2000s, making the empirical novelty limited to the specific cell line context rather than a new conceptual or mechanistic discovery.

writing_presentation.justification: The manuscript is incomplete, consisting only of a title with no abstract, methods, results, or discussion sections provided for review. This total absence of content makes it impossible to evaluate the clarity, organization, or presentation of the work.
